column3: Suspicious comments: matches are in the minified CesiumJS bundle, not in our code.
Storable and Cacheable Content: public terrain tiles and static assets, nothing user-specific is served.
CSP style-src unsafe-inline: CesiumJS widgets set inline styles; scripts stay locked to self.
Timestamp disclosure: numeric constants inside the minified CesiumJS bundle.
COEP missing: require-corp would block OpenStreetMap imagery, which sends no CORP header.
